author: CNN
description:
Pope Leo XIV is recovering at a Rome hospital after a “successful” surgery to remove part of his right lung which was found to have a cancerous growth, according to a statement from the Vatican. The Vatican announced Tuesday evening that the surgery had concluded “according to plan,” and that Leo “has returned to his room.”

“The Holy Father underwent thoracic surgery as scheduled,” said Dr. Luigi Carbone and Professor Stefano Margaritora in a statement. “The lower lobe of the right lung was removed using video-assisted surgery.” Further examination of the lobe revealed evidence of pulmonary adenocarcinoma, a common type of lung cancer, they said. The entire procedure lasted about 90 minutes.

description:
42-year-old Hassan Jihad Ibn Kariem of Atlanta died Monday after falling off the Goliath roller coaster at Six Flags Over Georgia near Atlanta. The ride has a top speed of 70 mph and a top height of 200 feet, according to Six Flags.

Onlookers at the park described seeing Kariem fall out of the coaster car and hit it three times before falling onto the roof of a haunted house attraction below. Six Flags has closed nine rides across its parks after the death, a spokesperson for the company said yesterday. The park is on weekend operations and is scheduled to open on Friday, the spokesperson said.
